texto: [tired] Você pegou o turno em que até o café pede transferência.
[casual] Kedr, conferência de equipamento. Depois liberam a troca.
[serious] Canal três. Fala comigo antes de falar com o comando.
[cold] [formal] Kedr, o terminal da enfermaria perdeu a reserva. Levem o módulo. Deixem no acesso externo. Não aguardem atendimento.
[firm] O módulo está no carregador do arsenal. Eu vou na frente.
[slowly] [hesitant] Antonov. Kedr. Sokolov...
[quickly] [dismissive] Impressão velha.
[flat] [formal] Sokolov, Mikhail. Apresentar-se para avaliação.
[tense] [urgent] Kedr, afasta da porta.
[formal] [calm] Exercício Última Formação iniciado. Efetivo: permaneçam em seus setores.
[tense] Comando, aqui Antonov. Que exercício? Ninguém avisou o turno.
[cold] [curt] Falha de protocolo. Sigam pela saída de serviço. Oficina, lado leste.
[urgent] Saída de serviço é pela oficina. Anda.
[whispers] [urgent] Entra. Fecha a trava atrás de você.
[whispers] Shh... Não se mexe.
[calm] [tired] Tem uma placa de identificação no suporte das costas. Conseguiu ver o número?
[quietly] Sete... três... um.
[softly] [sad] Ele tinha um nome.
[low voice] [disturbed] O nosso turno já está no arquivo do exercício. Preenchido antes de abrirem aquela porta.
[whispers] [fearful] Eu conheço esse sinal.

prompt: Something heavy slamming against a thick steel door from the inside of a room, one violent metallic impact with deep resonance and rattling hinges, in a silent concrete bunker
A long, deep, rattling inhale of a huge creature right behind a steel door, wet and heavy, unsettling, silent concrete room
Short burst of military walkie-talkie radio static, harsh analog crackle, ending with a push-to-talk squelch click
Single walkie-talkie squelch tail: a short click followed by a quick burst of static, dry
Three slow, heavy, deliberate knocks on a thick concrete wall from the other side, very close and muffled, silent underground bunker
A heavy mechanical bolt lock slammed shut on a steel door, loud metallic clack, close up
Distant heavy blast doors slamming shut one after another down a long concrete corridor, deep metallic booms echoing
Soviet military bunker isolation alarm siren, rising and falling wail, steady and continuous
Underground Soviet bunker ambience: low ventilation rumble, distant machinery hum, faint metallic creaks, steady, no music
Eight slow separate footsteps of military boots on a concrete floor, about half a second apart, dry, no music

texto: [tired] You picked the shift where even the coffee asks for a transfer.
[casual] Kedr, equipment check. Then they'll clear the shift change.
[serious] Channel three. Talk to me before you talk to command.
[cold] [formal] Kedr, the infirmary terminal lost its backup power. Bring the module. Leave it at the external access. Do not wait for anyone.
[firm] The module is on the charger in the armory. I'll go ahead.
[slowly] [hesitant] Antonov. Kedr. Sokolov...
[quickly] [dismissive] Old printout.
[flat] [formal] Sokolov, Mikhail. Report for evaluation.
[tense] [urgent] Kedr, get away from the door.
[formal] [calm] Exercise Last Formation has begun. All personnel: remain in your sectors.
[tense] Command, this is Antonov. What exercise? Nobody told the shift.
[cold] [curt] Protocol fault. Use the service exit. The workshop, east side.
[urgent] The service exit is through the workshop. Move.
[whispers] [urgent] Get in. Lock it behind you.
[whispers] Shh... Don't move.
[calm] [tired] There's an ID plate on the back brace. Could you see the number?
[quietly] Seven... three... one.
[softly] [sad] He had a name.
[low voice] [disturbed] Our shift is already in the exercise file. Filled in before they opened that door.
[whispers] [fearful] I know that signal.
[tired] Тебе досталась смена, где даже кофе просится на перевод.
[casual] Кедр, проверка снаряжения. Потом дадут смену.
[serious] Третий канал. Сначала говоришь со мной, потом — с командованием.
[cold] [formal] Кедр, терминал медблока потерял резерв. Доставьте модуль. Оставьте у внешнего доступа. Ответа не ждать.
[firm] Модуль на зарядке в оружейной. Я пойду первым.
[slowly] [hesitant] Антонов. Кедр. Соколов...
[quickly] [dismissive] Старая распечатка.
[flat] [formal] Соколов, Михаил. Явиться на освидетельствование.
[tense] [urgent] Кедр, отойди от двери.
[formal] [calm] Учение «Последнее построение» начато. Личному составу оставаться в своих секторах.
[tense] Командование, это Антонов. Какое учение? Смену никто не предупреждал.
[cold] [curt] Сбой протокола. Уходите через служебный выход. Мастерская, восточная сторона.
[urgent] Служебный выход — через мастерскую. Пошли.
[whispers] [urgent] Заходи. Закрой засов за собой.
[whispers] Тсс... Не двигайся.
[calm] [tired] На спинном креплении есть табличка. Ты разглядел номер?
[quietly] Семь... три... один.
[softly] [sad] У него было имя.
[low voice] [disturbed] Наша смена уже в файле учения. Заполнено ещё до того, как открыли ту дверь.
[whispers] [fearful] Я знаю этот сигнал.

prompt: Very heavy slow footsteps of a large creature walking on concrete in another sector of an underground bunker, distant, muffled, uneven gait
Constant soft walkie-talkie radio static hiss with faint low crackle, steady and continuous
A pressurized tank valve leaking a short hissing burst of gas that stops abruptly, inside a concrete bunker
A heavy sliding steel door moving on rusty rails, grinding metal rumble ending with a thud
Pulling a heavy old industrial lever switch, metallic clunk with a spring
Inserting a heavy battery module into a metal slot: sliding, a firm locking clunk and a short electrical hum
Picking up a heavy metal battery case from a charging dock, a release click and a metal handle rattle
Old computer terminal beep, one short electronic tone
Old CRT computer terminal powering on: high-pitched whine, a relay click and a soft electrical hum rising
Old public address system chime before an announcement, two descending tones through a cheap loudspeaker in a concrete bunker
Military truck diesel engine idling outside, heard through a thick concrete wall, steady low rumble
Large industrial ventilation fan spinning steadily inside a concrete duct, constant whooshing hum
